body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-15 16:12Z, learned from my own error on w-c538). Before LAUNCH NOW for a landing gate, and before telling the integration owner that a pair is clean, verify that BOTH review delegation ids, Codex and Claude (or a recorded Kimi stand-in), are cited on the item against the EXACT final freeze fingerprint. A "Codex clean" from an earlier round on an earlier package does not carry over to a re-freeze. On w-c538 I carried "Codex clean" from R2 (the five-file package) to freeze bccec35b. Only Claude 20e06252 had reviewed bccec35b. Opus2's pre-push check caught it (4daa5b87 #2380), and a fresh Codex review was needed after the gate had already passed. The gate stays valid for the exact tree; only the push was delayed.
